panels.is: Theresa May in her BBC interview (shot 1 of 3): seated, three-quarter, plum jacket, dark wood-panelled backdrop; framed waist up (locked).
Kemi Badenoch on a building site (shot 2 of 3): white hard hat, orange-and-navy hi-vis, pointing out to her side; site workers and wolves act behind her (locked framing).
Tony Blair in an armchair in his study (shot 3 of 3), just after the cut to him, before the double doors burst open; wolves not yet in the room.
Tony Blair (shot 3 of 3): staff and guests run out of the burst-open double doors across the room while wolves chase them.
